print(lo_search)

convert_script = '''\
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
from docx import Document

# Read the DOCX content
doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Extract all text content with structure
lines = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if text:
        lines.append(text)

# Also extract table content
for table in doc.tables:
    for row in table.rows:
        row_text = " | ".join(cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells)
        if row_text.strip().replace("|", "").strip():
            lines.append(row_text)

# Create PDF using PyMuPDF
pdf_doc = fitz.open()

# Page settings
page_width = 595  # A4 width in points
page_height = 842  # A4 height in points
margin = 72  # 1 inch margins
usable_width = page_width - 2 * margin
y_pos = margin
line_height = 14
title_height = 22
subtitle_height = 18

page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)

for line in lines:
    # Determine font size based on content
    if line == "Customer Activity Report":
        font_size = 18
        current_line_height = title_height + 8
    elif line.startswith("Order ORD-"):
        font_size = 10
        current_line_height = line_height + 2
    elif line.startswith("Email:") or line.startswith("Items:"):
        font_size = 9
        current_line_height = line_height
    elif "|" in line and ("Order ID" in line or "Amount" in line or "ORD-" in line):
        font_size = 10
        current_line_height = line_height + 2
    elif any(name in line for name in ["Maya Chen", "Jordan Alvarez", "Evan Parker", "Nina Patel", "Alicia Morgan", "Sofia Ramirez"]) and "Email" not in line and "Order" not in line:
        font_size = 14
        current_line_height = subtitle_height + 4
    else:
        font_size = 10
        current_line_height = line_height

    # Check if we need a new page
    if y_pos + current_line_height > page_height - margin:
        page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
        y_pos = margin

    # Insert text
    text_point = fitz.Point(margin, y_pos + font_size)
    page.insert_text(text_point, line, fontsize=font_size, fontname="helv")
    y_pos += current_line_height

pdf_doc.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf_doc.close()
print("PDF created successfully at /workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
